subject: [PATCH v2] memcg: keep folio's objcg same as its node

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner
reviews.summary:
Johannes Weiner suggested a helper function to always return a referenced objcg, get_migration_objcg(), which would simplify the code and make it easier to manage refcounting.

Johannes Weiner noted that the commit_charge() call in mem_cgroup_migrate() still uses the old objcg, which has been put by this point, and requested to drop the lock before calling try_to_unmap().

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged a concern about the behavior of get_migration_objcg() when there is a root mismatch, agreed that it must commit to the new objcg and explained how this affects the handling of page counters in mem_cgroup_replace_folio() and mem_cgroup_migrate(). The author provided a revised patch with the necessary changes.

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the get_migration_objcg() helper does not handle the case where new_nid is equal to folio_nid(old), and suggested using a helper that always returns a referenced objcg
reviews.raw_body:
Thanks a lot Johannes, this looks much better. I will incorporate this and run
through the reproducer before sending out the v3.

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch introduces a helper function get_migration_objcg() that returns the objcg (object cgroup) associated with a folio, ensuring it is referenced and consistent across node boundaries. The function is used in mem_cgroup_replace_folio() to update page counters and charges correctly when replacing a folio. This change simplifies the code and ensures accurate accounting of memory usage.
